method: Unedited screenshots of native dialog and decision-brief elements in a fresh Chrome context. All interaction uses normal visible controls with the supplied fictional worked example. No DOM, storage, case, model or result injection; no shared publication.

useCase.label: Review a first shipment
useCase.description: Can we meet this delivery commitment, and what should we verify before committing money?

collectionDetails.title: Choose a collection for the work you do
collectionDetails.alt: Order fulfillment collection details group shipment use cases, a standalone app and a guided review above the Install collection control.
collectionDetails.caption: A collection organizes related use cases, standalone apps and guided workflows. Install collection adds this release to your local Collections.

workflowNextStep.title: Start with the next required review
workflowNextStep.alt: The new shipment review opens its decision brief with Next review step, the responsible shipment-lead role, and a button to review shipment identity and units. Supporting findings remain collapsed.
workflowNextStep.caption: The worked example opens at the decision brief. Next review step takes the reviewer to the required task; it does not accept the supplied answer or run an assessment.

steps: Open Marketplace in a fresh browser context.
Open Order fulfillment collection details and capture the actual use-case, app, workflow and installation controls.
Select Install collection and wait for the installed Order fulfillment collection.
Open Guided reviews and select Try worked example for Review a first shipment.
Capture the initial decision brief and Next review step without accepting answers or evaluating supporting apps.
Export the initial workflow run through Review files & history.
Select Review answer: Shipment identity and units, then export the run again.
Verify the underlying run and frozen app identities are unchanged and all answers remain unaccepted with zero evaluations.
